Greetings,
I thought I should maybe voice my questions somewhere people know what I'm talking about instead of hitting my head on the wall repeatedly
If any of my questions seem ridiculously basic, I am very sorry! Genuinely! I haven't been able to do any complex coding much so I thought I should get an account here sorted out proper so I can ask questions when the time comes. As in, not now because my brain has melted ... good luck to everyone with the game making, and thank you to anyone who does not roll their eyes when I post about some elementary level problem in the future XD
Forgot to say I'm working with RPG maker MZ!  But the things that people make with MV are so incredible that it makes me second guess my choice at times
